selected_script.angle: Durable and hygienic alternative to moldy, high-maintenance wooden boards
selected_script.hook: Stop using wooden cutting boards that trap mold and bacteria.

video_001_part_01.visual: 0-3s: Close-up of a damp, stained wooden chopping board on a kitchen counter with visible surface cracks. 3-6s: A clean, silver stainless steel chopping board is placed flat on the counter, with its 1 cm downward-folded lip hooking securely over the front edge. 6-10s: Slicing fresh tomatoes quickly on the smooth, brushed metal surface. Handheld phone-shot style.
video_001_part_01.audio: Tired of wooden boards trapping stains and mold? Upgrade to a clean, durable solution. This stainless steel board sits securely on your counter and keeps prep completely hygienic.

video_001_part_02.visual: 0-4s: Slicing raw beef on the clean metallic surface. 4-8s: Rinsing the board effortlessly under the tap in a sink, showing food washing clean immediately. 8-10s: The clean board set neatly on a modern kitchen counter with text overlay: 'Upgrade your kitchen prep today.'
video_001_part_02.audio: It does not absorb odor, resists scratches, and washes clean in seconds. Make the smart kitchen upgrade today.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video, realistic handheld phone-shot (9:16). Timeline: 0-3s: Show a real-life pain conflict with a close-up of a damp, cracked, moldy wooden cutting board on a countertop. 3-6s: Introduce the product solution: a sleek silver stainless steel chopping board placed on the counter. It has rounded corners, a slim rigid profile, and one long edge bent downward into a 1 cm folded lip that hooks over the counter edge. 6-10s: Fast-cut scene 1 showing a chef's knife slicing fresh red tomatoes smoothly on the brushed metal surface. No handles, grooves, or feet. Do not show CTA.

Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video, realistic handheld phone-shot (9:16). Continuation of part 1. Keep identical product identity: silver metallic rectangular board with rounded corners and the 1 cm downward-folded lip. Timeline: 0-4s: Fast-cut scene 2 showing raw meat being sliced on the metallic surface without staining or absorbing odors. 4-8s: Fast-cut scene 3 showing a close-up of the board being rinsed under running water in a sink, cleaning instantly. 8-10s: Light CTA with text overlay: 'Upgrade your kitchen prep today.' next to the clean board.
